concepts.gloss_en: Ehyeh — the Divine Name 'I Will Be' (aspect of Keter/teshuvah)

reason_for_human: All five occurrences refer to the same Divine Name Ehyeh ('I Will Be'), consistently glossed as the aspect of Keter, honor, and teshuvah throughout LM 1:6. The variant spelling אקיה is the standard euphemistic substitution (ק for ה) to avoid writing the Name, not a different word; אֶהֱיֶה and the Psalms citation אֶהְיֶה are the same Name. No homograph is present.
